scenarios.name: ferocious-no-creature-with-power-four
scenarios.why: Whisperer itself has power zero and Grizzly Bears has power two, so no creature controlled meets the stated power threshold.

scenarios.name: ferocious-power-six-creature-meets-threshold
scenarios.why: Craw Wurm has power six, exceeding the four-power threshold; tapping Whisperer for its ferocious mana ability adds two green mana.
